<p>真实项目优化实录：从 5 秒白屏到 1.2 秒加载完成，Vite 项目性能优化全攻略，附可直接复用的代码片段。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">📊 优化成绩单</h2>



































<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>收益</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>首屏加载</strong></td><td>5.2 s</td><td>1.2 s</td><td>↓ 77 %</td></tr><tr><td><strong>LCP（最大内容绘制）</strong></td><td>4.1 s</td><td>1.0 s</td><td>↓ 76 %</td></tr><tr><td><strong>JS 体积</strong></td><td>1.8 MB</td><td>480 KB</td><td>↓ 73 %</td></tr><tr><td><strong>图片总重</strong></td><td>6.4 MB</td><td>1.9 MB</td><td>↓ 70 %</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">一、代码体积瘦身：Vite + 优化</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">1. 代码分割 + Tree-Shaking</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vue <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@vitejs/plugin-vue'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [<span class="hljs-title function_">vue</span>()],
  <span class="hljs-attr">build</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">rollupOptions</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">output</span>: {
        <span class="hljs-attr">experimentalMinChunkSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 设置模块大小大于20KB才会单独打包</span>
        <span class="hljs-title function_">manualChunks</span>(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) {
            <span class="hljs-attr">manualChunks</span>: {
                <span class="hljs-attr">vendor</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'vue-router'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'axios'</span>]
            }
        },
      },
    },
  },
});
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>代码分割</strong>：Vite 默认支持代码分割，通过 <code>manualChunks</code> 可以进一步自定义代码分割逻辑。</li>
<li><strong>Tree-Shaking</strong>：Vite 默认启用，移除未使用的代码。</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">2. 压缩代码</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vue <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@vitejs/plugin-vue'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { terser } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'rollup-plugin-terser'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [
    <span class="hljs-title function_">vue</span>(),
    <span class="hljs-title function_">terser</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">compress</span>: {
        <span class="hljs-attr">drop_console</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 移除 console.log</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">drop_debugger</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 移除 debugger</span>
      },
    }),
  ],
  <span class="hljs-attr">build</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">minify</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'terser'</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 指定使用 terser 进行压缩</span>
  },
});
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>terser</strong>：进一步压缩代码，移除 <code>console.log</code> 等调试信息。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">二、资源优化：图片、字体、静态资源</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">1. 图片优化</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>WebP/AVIF</strong>：使用现代图片格式，体积更小，质量更高。</li>
<li><strong>懒加载</strong>：按需加载图片，减少首屏加载时间。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vue <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@vitejs/plugin-vue'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">VitePluginLazyload</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite-plugin-lazyload'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [<span class="hljs-title function_">vue</span>(), <span class="hljs-title class_">VitePluginLazyload</span>()],
});
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">data-src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image.webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span> /&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript">
  <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    entries.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entry</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>;
        img.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = img.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">src</span>;
        img.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">remove</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'lazy'</span>);
      }
    });
  }).<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.lazy'</span>));
</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">2. 字体优化</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>按需加载</strong>：只加载需要的字体样式。</li>
<li><strong>预加载</strong>：使用 <code>&lt;link rel="preload"&gt;</code> 预加载关键字体。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">link</span> <span class="hljs-attr">rel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"preload"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">href</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/fonts/Roboto.woff2"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"font"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"font/woff2"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">crossorigin</span> /&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">三、网络优化：CDN、缓存</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">1. 使用 CDN</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>CDN</strong>：将静态资源部署到 CDN，减少服务器压力，加速加载。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vue <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@vitejs/plugin-vue'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [<span class="hljs-title function_">vue</span>()],
  <span class="hljs-attr">build</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">assetsDir</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'static'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">assetsInlineLimit</span>: <span class="hljs-number">4096</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 小于 4KB 的资源内联</span>
  },
});
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">2. 缓存策略</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>缓存控制</strong>：部署时缓存配置示例（Nginx）,把以下片段放进你的 Nginx 配置即可，不要写vite.config.js：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"># 静态资源缓存 <span class="hljs-number">1</span> 年
location ~* \.(?:js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot|avif|webp)$ {
  expires 1y;
  add_header <span class="hljs-title class_">Cache</span>-<span class="hljs-title class_">Control</span> <span class="hljs-string">"public, immutable"</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">四、首屏优化：骨架屏、预渲染</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">1. 骨架屏</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>骨架屏</strong>：在内容加载完成前显示占位图，提升用户体验。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton"</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton-header"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton-content"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: flex;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">flex-direction</span>: column;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">align-items</span>: center;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">justify-content</span>: center;
}
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton-header</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100%</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">50px</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">linear-gradient</span>(<span class="hljs-number">90deg</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#e0e0e0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>);
  <span class="hljs-attribute">background-size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">200%</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">animation</span>: skeleton <span class="hljs-number">1.5s</span> infinite;
}
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton-content</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100%</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200px</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">linear-gradient</span>(<span class="hljs-number">90deg</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#e0e0e0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>);
  <span class="hljs-attribute">background-size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">200%</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">animation</span>: skeleton <span class="hljs-number">1.5s</span> infinite;
}
<span class="hljs-keyword">@keyframes</span> skeleton {
  <span class="hljs-number">0%</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attribute">background-position</span>: -<span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  }
  <span class="hljs-number">100%</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attribute">background-position</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">2. 预渲染</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>预渲染</strong>：使用 Vite 插件进行预渲染，减少首屏加载时间。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vue <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@vitejs/plugin-vue'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> vitePrerender <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite-plugin-prerender'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [
    <span class="hljs-title function_">vue</span>(),
    <span class="hljs-title function_">vitePrerender</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">routes</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'/'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'/about'</span>], <span class="hljs-comment">// 必填</span>
    }),
  ],
});
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-13">五、性能监控：Lighthouse、Web Vitals</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">1. Lighthouse</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lighthouse</strong>：使用 Lighthouse 定期检查性能，找出瓶颈。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">npm install -g lighthouse
lighthouse https://your-site.com --view
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">2. Web Vitals</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web Vitals</strong>：监控关键性能指标，如 LCP、FID、CLS。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getCLS, getFID, getLCP } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'web-vitals'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">getCLS</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-property">log</span>);
<span class="hljs-title function_">getFID</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-property">log</span>);
<span class="hljs-title function_">getLCP</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-property">log</span>);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-16">六、代码优化：减少重绘、重排</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">1. 避免强制同步布局（FLS）</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>FLS</strong>：避免在 JavaScript 中频繁读写布局属性。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 避免</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = element.<span class="hljs-property">offsetWidth</span>;
element.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = width + <span class="hljs-number">10</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 推荐</span>
element.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = element.<span class="hljs-property">offsetWidth</span> + <span class="hljs-number">10</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">2. 使用 CSS 动画</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>CSS 动画</strong>：使用 CSS 动画而不是 JavaScript 动画，减少重绘和重排。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-keyword">@keyframes</span> fadeIn {
  <span class="hljs-selector-tag">from</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; }
  <span class="hljs-selector-tag">to</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; }
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"fade-in"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-19">七、总结：7 步优化流程</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>代码分割 + Tree-Shaking</strong>：减少代码体积。</li>
<li><strong>图片优化</strong>：使用现代格式、懒加载。</li>
<li><strong>网络优化</strong>：使用 CDN、设置缓存。</li>
<li><strong>首屏优化</strong>：骨架屏、预渲染。</li>
<li><strong>性能监控</strong>：Lighthouse、Web Vitals。</li>
<li><strong>代码优化</strong>：减少重绘、重排。</li>
<li><strong>持续优化</strong>：定期检查、优化。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-20">🏁 一句话总结</h2>
<p>通过 Vite + 7 招优化，我们的项目从 5 秒白屏降到 1.2 秒加载完成，性能提升 77%。把这份优化清单贴在工位</p></div></div>
